$comment: What any good explanation of this PR says, written by a model from the PR's title, description and diff only (scripts/eval-assertions.ts). The eval grades each run against them. Delete one that is wrong; keep them stable so evals compare.

assertions.text: Says that the PR adds a new send-invite API endpoint, backing the members-grid row action, that invites staged members by organization user id without changing their access.
Says that inviting a staged member moves their existing row to Invited status and emails them an invitation.
Says that OrganizationService's existing email-based invite path now detects staged members by email and promotes their existing rows in place instead of creating duplicates.
Says that the configurable invite dialog stays email-keyed because a staged member cannot be told apart from a new user by email alone, so the row action is separate.
Says that staged members hold no seat until invited, so inviting them counts toward Password Manager seat needs and may autoscale the subscription.
Says that the row-action command skips missing, other-organization or non-staged members and reports each individually, while seat expansion failure rejects the whole request.
Does not claim that inviting a staged user deletes and recreates the organization user, since the row keeps its Id and ExternalId.
Does not claim that the new send-invite row action lets admins set role, collections or groups; that is done through the invite dialog.
names the new command for inviting staged users
names the new batch repository lookup by emails
names the Staged organization user status
names the modified service for email-based invites
